dataset: Hilti 2022 exp21 / cam0 and alphasense IMU
method: t_imu = t_camera + saved_offset + injected_shift. R_candidate = R_camera_axis(injected_angle) @ R_saved; fixed IMU-frame gyro bias. Interval means use linear interpolation of sampled trapezoidal cumulative gyro integrals. The same camera intervals are used at every shift; no extrapolation.
limitations: Displayed development window only. Zero injection is the saved estimate, not clock truth. Camera tracking noise, timing, rotation and bias can all contribute to residuals. No optimizer, independent accuracy score or new calibration verdict.
